title: Brain2Qwerty: reconstructs exact typed sentences from EEG or MEG brain activity
description:
Brain2Qwerty reconstructs the exact sentence someone typed, straight from their brain activity, no implant required. This isn't decoding vague intent, it's recovering the actual words, keystroke by keystroke, from a participant sitting in an MEG or EEG scanner. The pipeline runs a convolutional encoder into a transformer, then a character-level language model cleans up the output. #github #opensource 

https://github.com/facebookresearch/brain2qwerty
